summary: redeem() checks then inserts without a lock or unique constraint; two threads both redeem
request: Let a user redeem a coupon code once; a second redeem for the same user must be refused.
ac: redeem(conn, code, user) returns True on the first redemption for that user.
A later redeem of the same code by the same user returns False.
Two redemptions of one code by different users both succeed.
